plan.title: perf(release): speed up routine cuts — skip scratch scans, document Step 5 modes

narratives.Description: Release Step 5 content/link/path walks still enumerate .deft-scratch worktrees in some scanners, slowing routine cuts. Default-exclude scratch/worktree noise, document routine vs hard Step 5 modes without silent coverage soft-pass, and add build-dist progress ticks.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Routine release cuts walk large .deft-scratch/worktrees trees during Step 5 content/link scans and feel stuck. Need default exclude + docs for routine vs hard cut; no silent coverage soft-pass.

## Scope (this PR)

A: Default-exclude .deft-scratch from remaining scanners (validate-links, codebase extractor, verify-stubs, build-dist).
B: Document routine vs hard cut in docs/RELEASING.md + release skill.
C: build-dist-runner progress ticks (low risk).
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #2953.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer cutting a routine release, I want Step 5 not to scan swarm scratch worktrees and clear routine vs hard-cut guidance, so cuts finish faster without weakening coverage safety.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Create branch feat/2953-release-perf.
2. Exclude .deft-scratch from validate-links, default-extractor, verify-stubs, build-dist DEFAULT_EXCLUDES; tests.
3. Document routine vs hard Step 5 in RELEASING.md and release skill (no silent soft-pass).
4. Progress ticks on build-dist-runner / buildArchive.
5. CHANGELOG Unreleased #2953.
6. Pre-PR, PR Closes #2953, merge, scope:complete.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. Release-related content/link/path walks skip .deft-scratch by default
2. Documented routine vs hard cut for Step 5; no silent coverage soft-pass
3. build-dist-runner reports stage progress
4. CHANGELOG Unreleased cites #2953
5. Closes #2953

narrative.Acceptance: Given markdown/link/path scanners used during task check / release Step 5, when walking a tree with .deft-scratch/worktrees/**, then those paths are not enumerated unless an explicit include-debug path is documented.

items.title: Document routine vs hard cut Step 5 modes

narrative.Acceptance: Given docs/RELEASING.md and the release skill, when an operator reads Step 5 guidance, then routine vs hard cut is explicit and coverage soft-pass remains only via existing hatch / skip-ci incident paths (no silent soft-pass).
Given build-dist-runner, when packaging, then stage progress is visible; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #2953.
